target: Cold launch to usable Home <=3 s in at least 95% of 20 trials
verification_method: Timed release-build launches; include failed/slow trials

target: Input-to-visible-move <=100 ms in at least 95% of 100 valid inputs
verification_method: Frame timestamps/profiling on the baseline device

target: Selected leaderboard response rendered <=3 s in at least 95% of 20 Wi-Fi trials; client timeout 10 s
verification_method: Record complete request-to-render time; do not silently exclude server cold starts

target: All five boards and core local actions work on first launch in airplane mode
verification_method: Fresh install offline walkthrough; verify persistent progress after restart

target: No timer/audio/animation progression after background lifecycle handler; no periodic network polling or background sync
verification_method: Lifecycle tests; 60-second background observation and network capture

target: HTTPS only; tokens in OS-backed secure storage; no privileged backend secrets in repo/app
verification_method: Config/repo/build inspection; verify secure-storage session adapter

target: Writes bound to authenticated guest; rankings expose only public score fields; expired sessions cannot write
verification_method: A02 authorization and cross-user integration tests

target: No dangerous runtime permissions; network access only
verification_method: Android manifest review and fresh-install permission walkthrough

target: Touch areas >=48 x 48 dp; body contrast >=4.5:1; target/completed-crate shapes differ
verification_method: Layout/contrast audit at smallest viewport; verify labels with TalkBack

target: Landscape Android 10+; no clipped board or overlapping controls at both defined viewports
verification_method: Screenshot/layout comparison with safe areas and 1.3x system text

target: No repeated idle network requests; leaderboard payload <=50 KB for 20 rows
Every acknowledged local action restores consistently; completion is atomic; duplicate sends create one receipt
verification_method: Fault injection around SQLite transactions and API retry integration tests
